//: Structured, non-secret settings. Copy to config.json (gitignored). Secrets go in .env, and any env var overrides the matching key here. Every field is optional — omit to take the default.
// providers.ownWork: May also be "codex" to run operator work through the OpenAI Codex SDK.
// models: Which model workers run. PIN REAL IDS, not the tier aliases: an alias means "whatever that family points at now" and moves under you on a release. Aliases below are only a spelling — the engine expands them to ids before the SDK sees them. `default` applies to every launch path that names no model of its own; NEO_WORKER_MODEL overrides it. `[1m]` is the 1M-context tag.
// decisionsChatId: Telegram chat/group id for the unmuted Decisions channel (blocking questions, escalations, failures). Also settable via DECISIONS_CHAT_ID. Unset → decisions post to the admin DM but stay tracked + reminded.
// secretaryCron: Digest cadence for the opt-in secretary loop (server-local cron). Default every 2h, 08:00-22:00. Turn the loop on with /loop secretary on.
// secretaryStaleHours: A decision waiting longer than this many hours is flagged STALE (an escalation) in the digest. Default 24.
// workers.secretary: Run the secretary digest on a specific model, e.g. "workers": { "secretary": { "model": "claude-opus-5-5[1m]" } }. Omit it to take models.default.
// workerEnv: Claude Code env knobs apply only with providers.ownWork="subscription". When ownWork="codex", CLAUDE_*, ANTHROPIC_*, and MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS are filtered before launch.
